highlight.title: Cloud Run's Game-Changing 2026 Updates: GPU Support, AI Integration & Billing Controls
highlight.summary: <cite index="1-36,3-12,3-19">Google unveiled major Cloud Run updates at Next '26, including GPU support with NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Edition, full-stack AI Studio integration, and upcoming billing caps for cost control.</cite> <cite index="1-28">New fine-grained IAM roles (Service Invoker, Jobs Executor) and enhanced security with explicit container image permissions now provide better least-privilege access control.</cite>

resources.title: App Engine Gen 1 Runtime Deprecation: Migration Hub to Cloud Run Now Available
resources.why_now: <cite index="21-1,21-3,24-3">Python 2.7 and other Gen 1 runtimes were deprecated on January 31, 2026, making migration to Cloud Run or Gen 2 runtimes urgent for teams still running legacy App Engine applications.</cite>

resources.title: GCP Cost Optimization Tools Report: 30-45% Savings Achievable in 2026
resources.why_now: <cite index="12-1,12-10,16-11">With organizations typically overspending 25-35% on GCP resources, new AI-driven cost optimization tools now deliver documented savings of 30-50% through automated rightsizing and anomaly detection.</cite>

resources.title: Secret Manager IAM Patterns: Workload Identity Best Practices for 2026
resources.why_now: <cite index="31-17,31-16">With the shift away from JSON service account keys, Workload Identity Federation and External Secrets Operator integration are becoming production standards for secure secret access in GKE.</cite>

resources.title: Cloud Run Functions GA: Complete App Engine Migration Path
resources.why_now: <cite index="1-14,1-38">Functions deployment in Cloud Run reached GA in 2026, providing a direct migration path for App Engine functions while enabling portability between Google's serverless platforms.</cite>

claude_take: The 2026 GCP landscape shows clear consolidation around Cloud Run as the unified serverless platform, with App Engine legacy migrations creating urgency for teams to modernize. Cost optimization is maturing beyond manual dashboards to AI-driven automation, while IAM patterns are shifting toward Workload Identity Federation as the security standard.
